message: You know that one friend who seems to panic at the slightest hint of trouble? I used to be a bit like that myself, always worried about what might happen. But I've learned that a little preparedness can go a long way in easing those worries. I came across a great resource that helps you build an emergency kit, which is such a practical step to feel more at ease. It’s all about having the basics covered, so you can focus on the moments that matter most. What’s one item you’d never want to be without in your kit?
